summary: A legal-heavy day with three High Court/Supreme Court matters affecting labour, land rights, and mobility regulation, plus a government mandate on smartphone accessories and India-NZ trade pact coming into force.

bullets.text: Karnataka HC upholds DRDO land acquisition, ruling national security trumps personal property rights in eminent domain case.
Five Karnataka auto and taxi driver unions file Supreme Court petition against HC verdict permitting bike-taxi operations.
Government mandates BIS certification for smartphone screen protectors effective April 1, 2027, bringing them under compulsory quality standards.
India-New Zealand FTA ratified and scheduled to take effect October 20, expanding bilateral trade framework.
Reliance announces Rs 10 lakh crore investment plan over 7 years to cut AI costs dramatically at India AI Summit.
